description: Update the user's own profile fields when they ask: timezone, name, headline, company website, LinkedIn URL or X handle. Only pass the fields they asked to change. timezone must be an IANA zone name — translate their words yourself ('ET', 'eastern time', 'Boston time' all mean America/New_York; 'PST' means America/Los_Angeles). Confirm what was set in your reply.

timezone.description: IANA zone name, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Empty string clears it.
